program.termination: END record followed by drain of all pending responses and all bank busy bits

bank_ownership_only.ownership: one exclusive owner per bank with no read/write distinction
bank_ownership_only.excluded: all bank payload read/write ports and address routing

execution_contract.issue_order: strictly increasing PC; blocked current command prevents lookahead
execution_contract.pc_advance: only on selected executor request acceptance; GEMM start is its acceptance event
execution_contract.multiple_outstanding: allowed when every required bank is free and target executor accepts
execution_contract.request_valid_rule: valid is asserted from buffered decoded command and bank eligibility independently of executor ready and remains stable until handshake
execution_contract.acquire_rule: one-cycle acquire owner code is emitted on the same edge as command acceptance
execution_contract.release_rule: one-cycle release is emitted on matching response acceptance independent of current PC
execution_contract.response_ready_rule: response ready outputs remain asserted whenever reset is released so pulse-style completion producers are not backpressured
execution_contract.bank_zero_rule: bank 0 is command BRAM and is illegal for DMA or GEMM operands
execution_contract.bank_conflict_rule: an operation requires every distinct referenced bank to have its single bank_busy bit deasserted
execution_contract.gemm_lock_rule: GEMM acquires one exclusive lock for every distinct activation weight and output bank; destination cannot alias either source
execution_contract.pending_identity: MM2S is keyed by destination bank, S2MM by source bank and GEMM by output bank with stored source-bank tuple
execution_contract.response_validation: tag or returned bank tuple must be legal and match a pending command before release
execution_contract.end_rule: END issues no executor request and waits until all pending entries and the single bank_busy vector are zero
execution_contract.error_rule: decode, missing-END, response identity or executor-status error stops new issue, continues accepting/releasing already pending completions, and asserts terminal error only after drain
execution_contract.simultaneous_completion_rule: independent MM2S, S2MM and GEMM responses may release different exclusively-owned banks in the same cycle
execution_contract.reset_rule: clears PC, buffered command, pending entries and acquire/release outputs; external bank subsystem shares reset

required_cases: two DMA_LOAD commands to different banks handshake before either completion
a second command using a busy bank stalls at the same PC until release
blocked current command never fetches or issues a later command
MM2S S2MM and GEMM typed fields exactly match the 128-bit record
request valid and every typed payload remain stable under ready backpressure
acquire pulses occur exactly on command acceptance with the correct opcode owner
responses release matching banks while dispatcher fetches checks or stalls on later commands
simultaneous independent completion responses generate all required releases
spurious zero wrong-type or mismatched response identity enters error-drain without an illegal release
executor error releases its owned banks and stops all later issue
GEMM destination-source alias and bank zero reject
END waits for pending table and the unified external bank_busy vector to clear
missing END by MAX_COMMANDS enters error-drain
reset in fetch issue blocked and drain states clears dispatcher ownership state

does_not_claim: BRAM or URAM arbitration and physical routing
board integration bitstream or physical-board validation
